Website discovery: the database domain www.corrada.it redirects (HTTP 301, checked 2026-10-27) to https://www.eglagroup.com/company/corrada-s-p-a, a page of the parent group's site. The company has no site of its own. The earlier draft called corrada.it a JavaScript-only SPA: wrong, the page is server-rendered (its text is in the HTML and in __NEXT_DATA__).

The e-mail address on the page is hidden by Cloudflare email protection: the text shows '[email protected]' and the link points to /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection; a crawler must decode the data-cfemail value (or fall back to the phone) rather than store the placeholder.

The group publishes an integrated annual report (2025 edition on 10 April 2026, ESEF format too), half-year reports, a code of ethics, a management and control model and whistleblowing documents on the governance page: public financial documents of the parent that cover the Corrada segment.
quote: Code of Ethics 2 Management and Control Model 3 Whistleblowing 10
